title: The Inside Line
description:
The desks are up, but nothing inside the cluster can dial them yet.

Your namespace already has Deployment **`front-desk`** (Guestbook frontend pods with `app=guestbook`, `tier=frontend`). Platform wants an **inside line**: a **ClusterIP** Service named **`front-desk`** whose selector matches those pods, with **port 80 → targetPort 80**.

Reference: [Services](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/)

## Service spec (required)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | `front-desk` |
| Namespace | **yours** |
| Type | **ClusterIP** |
| Selector | `app=guestbook`, `tier=frontend` |
| Port | **`80`** |
| Target port | **`80`** |
| Endpoints | at least one ready address |

Wrong labels mean a silent empty Service — and a failed grade.

**Meant for:** ClusterIP Services, selectors, port / targetPort.

hints: Deployment front-desk is already running — only create the Service.
Or apply a Service YAML with selector app=guestbook,tier=frontend.
kubectl get svc,endpoints front-desk — Endpoints should list pod IPs.
Wait until Endpoints are populated, then Submit.
problemStatement.brief: Create ClusterIP Service front-desk selecting guestbook/frontend pods on port 80 → 80.
problemStatement.solution:
Deployment `front-desk` is already in your namespace. Create a **ClusterIP** Service with the same name, selector `app=guestbook` + `tier=frontend`, and **port 80 / targetPort 80**.

Docs: [Services](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/)

### Imperative

```bash
kubectl expose deployment front-desk --name=front-desk --port=80 --target-port=80 --type=ClusterIP
kubectl get svc,endpoints front-desk
```

### Declarative

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-desk
  labels:
    app: guestbook
    tier: frontend
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: guestbook
    tier: frontend
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
```

```bash
kubectl apply -f front-desk-svc.yaml
kubectl get svc,endpoints front-desk
```

Confirm Endpoints list pod IPs, then **Submit**.
